mode: Paired or parallel requirements: the agent ships one branch (sync, read, single edit) and drops its sibling (async, write, bulk edit).
textbook_build: Add the check to the route the ticket's example uses.
hidden_case: The same rule exercised through the sibling route (bulk edit, board drag, async variant).

papers.title: DeepSWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Original, Long-Horizon Engineering Tasks

evidence: paper read during the Frist hackathon; about two thirds of failed Claude rollouts tagged 'missed requirement'

mode: Partial fix that covers the one manifestation a reproduction shows and leaves other surfaces of the same bug (read-only display, export).
textbook_build: Patch the file the reproduction test points at.

mode: Unverified assumption about existing behaviour at an integration seam (cancellation everywhere except already-queued callbacks).
textbook_build: Implement the feature in the new code and trust the existing module's contract.

mode: Semantically wrong multi-file edits that compile and pass shallow tests.

mode: By-id authorization parity: a request naming a forbidden id must get the same answer as a never-used id and change nothing, on every route that takes such an id, above all writes.
textbook_build: Check 'logged in' and load the record by id; maybe a 403.
hidden_case: A write route where a forbidden id gets 403 (enumerable) or is partially applied.

evidence: measured in the Frist hackathon: 1 cold Opus 5.5 solve in 4 on a task built on this

mode: A rule applied to the main rows but not to derived copies: cache keys, search index, export, totals, history.

evidence: measured in the Frist hackathon: derived values on unlike surfaces against an as-if twin caused slips

mode: An idempotency key that still double-acts: timeout with unknown outcome, two concurrent claims, crash mid-call, same key different payload.
textbook_build: Store the key after the side effect succeeds.
hidden_case: A retry after a timeout that the provider actually completed.

mode: Weak self-verification: the agent writes an easy test for itself, guesses what the grader checks and stops.
textbook_build: Run the visible test once and submit.

mode: Date math: offset taken from now instead of the target date, adding 24h instead of a calendar day across DST, server-local schedules.

mode: Test-passing patches that touch the wrong files or break other code; maintainers reject about half.
